integration-window.description: Demand integration interval length. Common values: `900` (15 min), `1800` (30 min), `3600` (1 hour).

current-interval-demand.description: Running average over the currently-open interval; resets at each interval boundary.

previous-interval-demand.description: Closed value of the most-recently-completed interval.

peak-demand-this-period.description: Highest `previous-interval-demand` observed since the most recent peak reset.

peak-demand-time.description: Timestamp (ISO-8601 UTC) of the interval that produced `peak-demand-this-period`.

peak-demand-reset-time.description: When `peak-demand-this-period` was last reset (typically the start of the current billing period). ISO-8601 UTC.
